outcome: Maternal CD4+ cell microchimerism in umbilical cord blood
cohort: 37 HIV-infected mothers and their 39 newborns with normal MTCT risk according to the German Austrian Guidelines
finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery in HIV-infected women with normal MTCT risk was associated with lower maternal CD4+ cell transfer to newborns compared to planned cesarean section.
mod_finding: Planned cesarean section was associated with higher maternal CD4+ cell transfer to newborns compared to spontaneous vaginal delivery in HIV-infected women with normal MTCT risk.
